purpose: Accept files through drag and drop or the system picker, validate them, and compose file lists with upload progress and removal actions.

notes: Use VeliProvider for localized upload text, statuses, action labels, and direction.

useWhen: Users need to attach one or more files by dropping or browsing.
The UI must show accepted files, rejection feedback, upload progress, previews, or removal controls.

avoidWhen.situation: The workflow does not accept files.
avoidWhen.guidance: Choose the form control that matches the value being collected.

supportedInteractions: Open the system file picker by click, Enter, Space, or trigger button
Validate by type, size, count, or custom rule
Report upload progress, success, and error
Remove individual files or clear the list
approvedPatterns: Compose Dropzone with DropzoneArea and optionally DropzoneList, item parts, progress, and clear actions.
State accepted types, size limits, and count limits near the target.
Surface rejection messages outside the target when users need persistent detail.
Use DropzoneField for the simpler labeled field composition.
limitations: Upload transport is consumer-supplied through the upload callback.
File acceptance is checked after drop; dragover feedback may accept generic OS file payloads.
Compound child components must remain inside Dropzone, and item parts must remain inside DropzoneItem.
accessibility: Uses React Aria DropZone, FileTrigger, Button, and ProgressBar primitives.
The drop target supports keyboard activation and has an accessible upload label.
File rows expose list position, metadata, status text, and named removal actions.
responsive: File lists may be vertical or wrap horizontally; choose orientation for available space.
rtl: The root applies the active language and direction.
File names use automatic direction while sizes and percentages remain LTR.
